scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained for arbitrary finite grid dimensions; numerical checks are finite corroboration only. Possible equivalence with classical cosine differentiation weights and wider semigroup theory remains a priority risk. No independent scientific review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional exact, unfiltered cell-centered Neumann DCT-II diffusion only. The time of entrywise positivity recovery is sharp only for three nodes; the bound for larger grids is sufficient, not necessary. No variable coefficients, nonlinear terms, fully discrete time integration, or smooth-data maximum-principle theorem is asserted.
title: Checkerboard cosine diffusion couplings and the sharp Neumann-grid positivity boundary
